title: WavePoint
tagline: Indoor/outdoor campus navigation with autonomous routing
description: A full-stack campus navigation platform combining React Native, Expo, Supabase, and custom Python computer vision pipelines to deliver indoor/outdoor routing, accessibility-focused navigation, live friend tracking, and event coordination.

title: SkyPocket
tagline: Intelligent travel companion for shopping & budgeting abroad
description: A travel companion app for trip planning, expense tracking, and shopping abroad. Real-time currency conversion, Google Vision product identification, and price comparison across regions — wrapped in a finance dashboard that scales to 20+ simultaneous trips.

title: AllClear
tagline: Real-time emergency response platform for disaster awareness
description: A web app that keeps users informed during natural disasters — real-time hazard updates, weather overlays, and trusted-contact location sharing. Built in 36 hours during the Open Summer Hackathon, integrating OpenWeatherMap data, multi-hazard Leaflet overlays, and JWT-authenticated sessions.

title: UsherBot
tagline: Autonomous ROS2 robot for real-world indoor ushering
description: An autonomous ushering platform integrating a Next.js reservation system with a ROS2/Nav2 mobile robot that physically escorts users to reserved seats. Built distributed infrastructure using Supabase-backed message queues, concurrent Python ROS2 nodes, and real-time navigation telemetry synchronized across isolated lab networks.

title: Excel with Dell
tagline: Enterprise AI analytics platform for customer feedback
description: Selected as 1 of 51 students in Dell’s technical case competition to design enterprise AI analytics solutions. Built an end-to-end NLP pipeline using topic modeling and sentiment analysis, paired with an interactive React dashboard for KPI visualization and customer feedback exploration.

title: Wamp+
tagline: Interactive housing and apartment discovery platform
description: A full-stack apartment housing platform designed to streamline student housing discovery with interactive maps, real-time leasing visualization, and dynamic filtering across 35+ apartment listings. Built scalable backend infrastructure with PostgreSQL and Supabase.

title: Stellar Learning
tagline: Frontend at a free, AI-powered learning platform
description: Built and optimized scalable front-end systems for an AI-powered educational platform serving 25,000+ users. Developed engaging interfaces, gamified learning mechanics, and real-time progress tracking features to improve user retention and learning experience.

title: Osaka Dash
tagline: Unity RPG — explore the city, complete quests, learn culture
description: An immersive Unity RPG blending exploration, historical education, and minigames. Players navigate Osaka, complete quests from NPCs, and learn about cultural landmarks, transit systems, and city navigation along the way.

title: Kingdom Builder
tagline: Java strategy board game with full game logic
description: A complete digital adaptation of the strategy board game. Java AWT and Swing power the interactive GUI — card drawing, settlement placement, terrain highlighting, endgame scoring — with full turn-state handling and dynamic rendering across rounds.
